messages.author: 8a98edc55c6202fc
messages.subject: Re: Cannot access the website from workplace
parts:
if you can access it from other places probably the port is blocked by your workplace.
Ask the IT department if that is the case.
Then you will need to use apache to redirect a subfolder or subdomain to the shiny port.
